name: 02_create_template
task: In 1C Configurator, in the window on the right with the tree of the configuration extension 'api', inside the HTTP service 'api_http', create a NEW URL template. Its name and template string are set by the next task. Do not save the configuration.
rules: Work ONLY in the right window with the 'api' tree and in property windows ('Свойства: ...'). Never rename or change existing objects such as demo_status, GET or api_http. Do not delete anything. Never press Ctrl+S or F7. Do not use search boxes.

subgoals.goal: Select the URL template node 'demo_status' (NOT its child GET) in the right tree with a single click on the text 'demo_status'.
subgoals.check: In this tree the highlighted (blue selected) node is 'demo_status' itself, not 'GET'.

subgoals.goal: Add a new URL template: RIGHT-CLICK on the tree node 'demo_status' in the right window to open its context menu. Then, in the context menu, click the item 'Добавить' (Add). If a submenu appears, choose the item for adding a URL template ('Шаблон URL').
subgoals.check: A new URL template has appeared: a new node like 'Шаблон1' in the right tree near demo_status, or a properties window titled like 'Свойства: Шаблон1', or a window for entering the new object's name.
